items.title: Mistral opened its trillion-parameter model
items.oneliner: Mistral released 1T open weights for Large 4, making private deployment of frontier-scale models newly practical.

items.title: A Nintendo runs inside Qwen weights
items.oneliner: Nesformer packs a working NES into about 1GB of Qwen weights, blurring emulator engineering and model design.

items.title: Claude Code extension shipped a backdoor
items.oneliner: The Claude Code VS Code extension version 2.1.313 carried an SSH backdoor, turning your IDE into an attack path.

items.title: Binance lost billions in minutes
items.oneliner: Hackers stole $6.3B from Binance in 20 minutes, proving crypto security still fails at nation-state speed.

items.title: Northflank users were told to rotate secrets
items.oneliner: Northflank disclosed a breach and warned users to rotate AI keys immediately, a nightmare scenario for hosted workloads.

items.title: Polymarket halted after vendor compromise
items.oneliner: Polymarket paused trading for nearly an hour after a third-party compromise reportedly drained about $2.65M from wallets.

items.title: Amazon's AI bill hit cash flow
items.oneliner: Amazon posted $46.0B in sales, but AI spending helped swing free cash flow to a $42.4B outflow.

items.title: Deepgram bought Daily for voice infrastructure
items.oneliner: Deepgram is buying Daily to own more of the voice stack, while keeping Pipecat open source for developers.

items.title: A bulk inference server targets decisions
items.oneliner: Spinf-serve uses one 24GB GPU to score many questions from one read, which is exactly how inference costs get tamed.

items.title: Rust panic paths got a new analyzer
items.oneliner: Call Graph Analyzer traces panic paths from monomorphized MIR, giving Rust teams a sharper way to audit failure modes.
